caption: The WirelessHART stack. The data link is where the timing and the hopping live; the transport layer above it handles end-to-end reliability and retries; the PHY below is plain 802.15.4 at 2.4 GHz.

spec.aria: WirelessHART stack with five layers: application for HART commands, transport for end-to-end reliability and retries, network for the mesh, data link for TDMA with 10 ms slots, and 802.15.4 PHY at 2.4 GHz.
